meta.name: lark-workflow-standup-report
meta.description: 日程待办摘要：编排 calendar +agenda 和 task +get-my-tasks，生成指定日期的日程与未完成任务摘要。适用于了解今天/明天/本周的安排。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动汇总日程与待办，生成每日工作摘要
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要快速了解当日日程和未完成任务
copy.tagline_en: Automatically summarize calendar and tasks for daily standup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a quick daily summary of your schedule and pending tasks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能获取指定日期的日历日程和未完成任务，并生成包含时间、事件、待办事项和冲突提醒的摘要。
howto.when: 当你询问今天、明天或本周的安排，如“今天有什么安排”、“明天日程与待办”或“早报摘要”时触发。

say.note: Claude 会获取今日日程和待办并生成摘要。

say.text: 帮我看看明天的日程和未完成任务。
say.note: Claude 会获取明日数据并汇总。
Claude 会获取本周日程和待办。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can retrieve calendar events and incomplete tasks for a specified date, then generate a summary including time, events, to-dos, and conflict alerts.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about today's, tomorrow's, or this week's schedule, e.g., 'What's on my schedule today?', 'Tomorrow's agenda and tasks', or 'Morning briefing'.

say_en.note: Claude will fetch today's events and tasks and generate a summary.

say_en.text: Show me tomorrow's agenda and pending tasks.
say_en.note: Claude will retrieve tomorrow's data and summarize.

say_en.text: What are my plans for this week?
say_en.note: Claude will fetch this week's events and tasks.
